tools.name: doc_write
tools.description:
Edits to the open document (a file whose kind is DOC). Edits apply live for anyone viewing the document. Requires edit access. Call as {"action": "<name>", "params": {...}}.

Read the document first (doc_read): paths shift as blocks are added or removed, and replace_blocks / delete_blocks must pass

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: auth, doc_write, files_read, files_write, read_data, slide_read, slide_write · Private data: auth, doc_read, doc_write, files_read, files_write, read_data, slide_read, slide_write, write_data · Public sink: auth, read_data, slide_write, write_data · Destructive: doc_read, doc_write, files_write, slide_read, slide_write, write_data.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: auth, doc_write, files_read, files_write, read_data, slide_read, slide_write · Private data: auth, doc_read, doc_write, files_read, files_write, read_data, slide_read, slide_write, write_data · Public sink: auth, read_data, slide_write, write_data · Destructive: doc_read, doc_write, files_write, slide_read, slide_write, write_data

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
